sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_rows, COUNT("ODP 967 wet-dry index") AS non_null_index, COUNT("Age_ky.3") AS non_null_age3, COUNT(DISTINCT "Age_ky.3") AS distinct_ages, COUNT(*) - COUNT(DISTINCT "Age_ky.3") AS dup_age_pairs, MIN("Age_ky.3") AS min_age, MAX("Age_ky.3") AS max_age FROM climateMeasurements

WITH s AS ( SELECT "Age_ky.3" AS age_ky, "ODP 967 wet-dry index" AS idx FROM climateMeasurements WHERE "ODP 967 wet-dry index" IS NOT NULL AND "Age_ky.3" IS NOT NULL ), d AS ( SELECT idx - LAG(idx) OVER (ORDER BY age_ky) AS diff FROM s ) SELECT COUNT(idx) AS n_years, COUNT(diff) AS n_comparisons, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE diff > 0) AS n_increasing, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE diff > 0) / COUNT(diff), 2) AS pct_increasing FROM (SELECT * FROM s) t LEFT JOIN (SELECT diff, ROW_NUMBER() OVER () AS rn FROM d) x ON TRUE

WITH s AS ( SELECT "Age_ky.3" AS age_ky, "ODP 967 wet-dry index" AS idx FROM climateMeasurements WHERE "ODP 967 wet-dry index" IS NOT NULL AND "Age_ky.3" IS NOT NULL ), d AS ( SELECT LAG(idx) OVER (ORDER BY age_ky) AS prev_idx, idx, idx - LAG(idx) OVER (ORDER BY age_ky) AS diff FROM s ) SELECT COUNT(*) AS n_years, COUNT(diff) AS n_comparisons, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE diff > 0) AS n_increasing, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE diff > 0) / NULLIF(COUNT(diff),0), 2) AS pct_increasing FROM d

WITH s AS ( SELECT "Age_ky.3" AS age_ky, "ODP 967 wet-dry index" AS idx FROM climateMeasurements WHERE "ODP 967 wet-dry index" IS NOT NULL AND "Age_ky.3" IS NOT NULL ), d AS ( SELECT age_ky - LAG(age_ky) OVER (ORDER BY age_ky) AS age_step, idx - LAG(idx) OVER (ORDER BY age_ky) AS diff FROM s ) SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE age_step IS NOT NULL AND age_step <> 0.5) AS gaps, MIN(age_step) AS min_step, MAX(age_step) AS max_step, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE diff = 0) AS n_ties, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE diff < 0) AS n_decrease, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE diff > 0) AS n_increase, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE diff = 0) + COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE diff < 0) + COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE diff > 0) AS sum_check FROM d
